main_result.statement: For rank-exactly-three symmetric A, independent cap-one original coordinates, arbitrary affine term, and any literal physical pair I with T_I=sum_{k notin I}|det A[I union {k}]|>0, Q has an absolutely continuous law and ||p_Q||_inf,ess <= 24(3+sqrt(2))10^(2/3) T_I^(-1/3). The bound includes exactly singular physical pairs by a rank-preserving spectral perturbation and weak-limit interval domination.

actual_application.inequality: T_ij=S_i q_j>=1/8 on the transverse-heavy target branch, hence ||p_Q||_inf,ess<983.471 even if the physical pair is exactly isotropic.

partner_result_applied.application: If the same literal transverse-heavy pair is definite and |det A[I,I]|>=1/16, ||p_Q||_inf,ess<=4*pi<12.567.

next_step: Retain the at-most-three longitudinal spike coordinates jointly with the heavy hub and residual product tail, or equivalently prove the remaining shared-shear product-projection Borel tube without a curved-fiber supremum.
